outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 30–85, image and wrist_image), then pulls the upper drawer outward, exposing its sides and the opening behind its front (frames 103–123, image and left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws while the drawer remains visibly open (frames 148–155, all three cameras). No failed acquisition, harmful side effect, or sustained unproductive behavior is established.
